title.value: Metrics Reloaded – A new recommendation framework for biomedical image analysis validation
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the focus of the paper which is the development of a framework for validation metrics in biomedical image analysis.
title.quote: Metrics Reloaded – A new recommendation framework for biomedical image analysis validation

extractions.description: The paper presents a new recommendation framework for the selection of performance metrics in biomedical image analysis. The framework involves creating a problem fingerprint that categorizes problems and guides the selection of appropriate metrics. This process aims to address the limitations of current metric selection in biomedical image analysis, offering a structured approach to align metrics with the specific characteristics of biomedical problems. The paper is a collaborative effort involving experts from multiple institutions.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is the development of a framework for selecting performance metrics in biomedical image analysis, which is not directly related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: The paper presents a new recommendation framework for the selection of performance metrics in biomedical image analysis.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper outlines a validation framework specific to biomedical image analysis, focusing on metric selection for performance assessment, which is distinct from predefined Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development categories.
new_primary_category.quote: Metrics are the performance measures that typically compare a reference annotation with the prediction generated by an image analysis algorithm.
